newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint slips vs dlr, BCE lira most traded.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint slips vs dlr, BCE lira most traded.

text.p: The Hungarian forint closed a sluggish interbank forex market on Thursday weaker against the dollar, dealers said.
The forint finished at 155.32/37 against the U.S. unit compared with its opening of 155.20/25.
"The forint traded close to the central bank's bid (resistance level) for most of the day and turnover remained low," said Istvan Gere of ING Bank.
On the Budapest Commodities Exchange (BCE), yen futures were the main movers, dropping in four maturities. The dollar also finished lower in three maturities.
The Ecu rose in three maturities, sterling ended higher in two and the Italian lira finished mixed.
German mark and Swiss franc futures ended mostly steady.
Italian lira contracts accounted for 24,370 of the total 40,395 contracts, representing a turnover of 5.6 billion forints.
